assignments.value: Working from home, prone to seasonal fatigue, sensitive to pollen/dust.

parameters.text:
=You are my morning well-being coach. Write today's briefing from these real conditions.

My profile: {{ $json.healthFocus }}

Today's conditions ({{ $json.location }}, {{ $json.date }}):
- Sunrise {{ $json.sunrise }} / sunset {{ $json.sunset }}
- Now: {{ $json.temperatureC }}C (feels like {{ $json.feelsLikeC }}C), cloud cover {{ $json.cloudCoverPct }}%, humidity {{ $json.humidityPct }}%
- UV: {{ $json.uvIndexNow }} now, peaking at {{ $json.uvIndexMaxToday }} around {{ $json.peakUvHour }}
- Air: PM2.5 {{ $json.pm25 }} ug/m3, PM10 {{ $json.pm10 }} ug/m3, dust {{ $json.dust }} ug/m3, European AQI {{ $json.europeanAqi }} ({{ $json.airQualityLevel }})
- Pollen: strongest today is {{ $json.topPollenType }} at {{ $json.topPollenValue }} grains/m3 ({{ $json.pollenLevel }})

My timetable today:
{{ $json.scheduleText }}

Write exactly these three short parts:
1. Circadian: the best time window today to step outside for natural light, fitted around my classes.
2. Air and movement: whether it is safe to open windows, and outdoor vs indoor workout - with the reason and the best slot around my classes.
3. One grounding affirmation tailored to today's weather.

Under 120 words, warm and concrete, plain text only, no headings.

nodeGroups.name: Collect local conditions
nodeGroups.description: Stores your location and health focus, then pulls weather, UV, air quality and your HHS timetable.

nodeGroups.name: Reason and deliver
nodeGroups.description: Trims the raw API data, adds today's classes, asks OpenAI for the briefing, and posts it to Discord.
